events.verdict: Sengun (HOU) cuts towards the basket and Shead (TOR) briefly places an arm on his back as he attempts to disengage.
Shead (TOR) legally contests VanVleet's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) briefly grasps Barnes' (TOR) jersey and the additional body contact is marginal as Barnes receives the pass.
Sengun (HOU) legally contests Battle's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Smith Jr. (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in Shead's (TOR) path and does not deliver contact.
Smith Jr. (HOU) rests a hand on Dick's (TOR) back before elevating to contest. The contact with Dick's hand after the release is incidental.
Green (HOU) lifts his pivot foot prior to the release of his dribble.
